sources.citation: Moyse-Faurie, Claire. 2004. Catégorisation lexicale et problème de l'opposition verbo-nominale. Mémoire d'HDR, Université Paris X-Nanterre (§ F-1 'Le fagauvea', p. 90ff).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Fagauvea stress. The Fagauvea section (F-1) is syntactic (clitic pronouns, argument markers, noun-verb opposition); its only phonological remark is vowel lengthening in the first or second syllable for plural (fafine/faafine, tama/tamaa). All 'accent' passages in the HDR concern Xârâcùù (Rivierre 1978 accent coupling) or Tagalog, not Fagauvea.
